title: Silver Saver Account: Understanding the $25K Balance Threshold
summary: This document explains how the Silver Saver Account $25K balance threshold affects APY tiering: when your qualifying balance meets/exceeds $25K, your APY is 4.0%. It also coordinates the monthly maintenance fee waiver—requires a minimum $10,000 minimum daily balance—and provides scenarios about dips, deposit timing, and large outgoing payments during evaluation periods.
